name: components.work
summary: Copy-paste Next.js components for marketing sites: heroes, features, CTAs, FAQs, pricing, headers and footers.
description: A collection of type-safe React and TypeScript components for building Next.js landing pages, styled with Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui. Components are grouped into hero, feature, CTA, FAQ, pricing, header and footer sections; you copy a component from the site or the GitHub repo and paste it into your app.
